question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Aggregate .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aggregate"** is correctly spelt.
 
• It means to combine or sum up multiple elements into a whole.
 
• Options 1, 3, and 4 are incorrect spellings of the word.

Correct sentence: *The correct spelling is **"Aggregate"**, which refers to a total amount or sum of individual parts.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common usage:**

 
 
• It is often used in mathematics, business, and daily life to describe a collection or sum.
 
• **Example:** The aggregate score of the team was 250.
 
 
 
• **Synonyms:** Total, sum, collection, entirety.
 
• **Antonyms:** Individual, single, separate.
